format: Ink/inkjs pattern, hand-shaped JSON (NOT ink compiler output, NOT copied Pokemon lines). Shape: story -> knots -> stitches -> lines / choices. A choice has: text, optional condition, optional setFlags, and either target {knot, stitch} or exit:true. A stitch ends with an explicit exit:true line or a choice list; a stitch with neither fails validation. Runtime mapping: inkjs Story.ChooseChoiceIndex / Continue, or this JSON consumed directly by the React dialogue box (see dialogue-system.md). All dialogue below was written fresh for Mochiichao for this slice.

choices.text: I will come back when I have earned one.

lines.speaker: Dojo Acolyte
lines.text: This gate opens for trainers who already carry a Dojo Fragment. Yours is not on this road yet.

lines.speaker: Dojo Acolyte
lines.text: A Fragment, true and steady. The gate is open to you. Walk in with respect.

choices.text: What lies on the north road?

lines.speaker: Harbor Guide
lines.text: Morning, traveler. The data-tides have been restless since the harbor lights flickered last night.

lines.speaker: Harbor Guide
lines.text: If your partner is worn out, the rest bench by the lantern row will put them right. Ask me anything else, and I will point you true.

lines.speaker: Harbor Guide
lines.text: North is the old signal road. It is open to anyone traveling with a partner at their side.

lines.speaker: Harbor Guide
lines.text: Travel light, keep your partner close, and mind the tall signal-grass. Wild partners gather there.

lines.speaker: Road Watcher
lines.text: Hold on — the signal-grass north of here is no place to walk alone.

lines.speaker: Road Watcher
lines.text: Find a partner first. The lab door with the round window is where partnerships begin.

lines.speaker: Rest Keeper
lines.text: There. Bright-eyed and steady again. Come back whenever the road wears you down.

lines.speaker: Rest Keeper
lines.text: Sit a while. The bench hums low when it works — that hum means your partner is mending.

lines.speaker: Victory Gatekeeper
lines.text: Not yet. The arch stays shut until all eight Fragments are yours — no fewer, no shortcuts.

choices.text: I still have halls ahead of me.

lines.speaker: Victory Gatekeeper
lines.text: Past this stone arch is the Victory Route. It does not ask for strength alone — it asks for proof of the whole journey.

lines.speaker: Victory Gatekeeper
lines.text: Eight Dojo Fragments, each earned in its own hall. Count yours before you ask to pass.

lines.speaker: Victory Gatekeeper
lines.text: Eight, counted and true. The arch is yours. What waits beyond it has waited for a trainer like you.
